input.summary: Implemented the Task Management API system. The system is event-driven, with services for Users, Projects, Tasks, Comments, and Notifications. An API Router handles HTTP requests. A demo script is included to showcase creating users, projects, tasks, assigning tasks, adding comments, and receiving notifications.
